title: Vowel reduction in conversational Spanish by L1 and L2 speakers — manual validation subset
why_promising: Primary conversational production study isolates 1,043 Spanish vowels with boundaries manually assigned; duration and F1-F3 were computed from those human boundaries. This is an admissible manual subset if the observations are publicly deposited.
open_question: Locate authoritative public data deposit and isolate the 1,043 manually bounded tokens from the much larger forced-aligned dataset; inventory token variables and preserve manual-vs-automatic comparison fields.

title: The perception-production link in L2 vowel imitation by Mandarin learners of English
why_promising: All recorded imitation vowels were manually bounded in Praat by three phonetically trained RAs; 12% were independently annotated by all three. Duration and F1/F2 derive from the human intervals; reported reliability alpha=.92 F1, .80 F2, .86 duration.
open_question: Locate/enumerate the public repository and ingest all trial-level production variables, original Hz/duration and normalized Bark/z values if deposited; keep perception results linked but outside production core.

title: Sentences used in the speech-to-song illusion: Comparisons of acoustic vowel space
why_promising: The study reports that all recordings were manually segmented in Praat with separate word, phoneme, and vowel TextGrid tiers, making the non-singing spoken recordings potentially valuable dense manual annotation data.
open_question: Verify recordings are primary to the study, locate a public repository/supplement containing TextGrids or token measurements, and exclude any transformed/music-like derivative if present while retaining ordinary speech production.

title: Rapid-ToBI for Phrasing: Comparing Methods for (Faster) Annotation of Prosodic Phrase Structure
why_promising: Study directly compares human ToBI-style prosodic phrase annotation with speeded Rapid-ToBI and automatic wavelet decisions; potentially valuable manual prosodic labels if tied to primary speech recordings.
open_question: Determine recording lineage and whether manual/Rapid-ToBI annotation files are publicly deposited; admit only primary-recording human annotation layers and exclude purely automatic predictions.
